warnings.headline: On the mountains wind gusts up to 37 m/s are expected
warnings.description:
In the Dolný Kubín district winds are expected to rise in some mountain areas
reaching in short blows impact speed of up to 30 - 37 m/s (110 - 135 km/h).
The predicted wind speed is typical for the area and time of the year
it can however pose potential risk for human activities.
warnings.instruction:
BE AWARE, keep up to date with the latest weather forecast.
Expect some minor disruption to outdoor activities.

warnings.headline: Yellow Strong wind warning for Poland - Malopolskie Province Gorlicki County
warnings.description: It is forecasted strong wind with mean speed to 40 km/h and gusts up to 80 km/h, from south.
warnings.instruction: BE AWARE of debris being blown around. Localised outdoor activity disruption is possible due to debris.
